'''Pal Goral''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==History==
Pal Goral was a poor [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of this world, the [[Palarian]]s, were often recruited to work on the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] world of [[Duroon]]. Once there, however, the promised jobs turned out to be a position of near-slavery, and the Palarians were forced to mine the planet's vast resources alongside other indentured species. The Palarians did not take this turn of events laying down, and started a guerrilla war against the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]].<ref name="TEA" />
